title.value: PhAST: Physics-Aware, Scalable, and Task-Specific GNNs for Accelerated Catalyst Design
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: PhAST: Physics-Aware, Scalable, and Task-Specific GNNs for Accelerated Catalyst Design

extractions.description: The paper introduces PhAST, a framework to improve the accuracy and scalability of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for catalyst discovery, which is crucial for reducing carbon emissions in industrial processes and enabling low-carbon energy storage. PhAST includes innovations in graph creation, atom representations, energy prediction, and force prediction, enhancing computational efficiency and accuracy. The framework is evaluated on the Open Catalyst Project OC20 dataset.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly states the importance of catalyst materials for reducing carbon emissions and enabling low-carbon energy storage, which are key aspects of sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Mitigating the climate crisis requires a rapid transition towards lower-carbon energy. Catalyst materials play a crucial role in the electrochemical reactions involved in numerous industrial processes key to this transition, such as renewable energy storage and electrofuel synthesis.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on catalyst design for electrochemical reactions to reduce carbon emissions and develop infrastructures for storing low-carbon energy, which are direct mitigation strategies.
primary_category.quote: To mitigate climate change at a global scale, it is imperative to reduce the carbon emissions of ubiquitous industrial processes like cement production or fertiliser synthesis, as well as to develop infrastructures for storing low-carbon energy at scale, enabling to re-use it wherever and whenever needed.

primary_sub_category.justification: The primary application of the improved catalyst design is in various industrial processes to reduce carbon emissions, making 'Industry' the most relevant sub-category.
